subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the active union_id PR depends on an identity source that the reporter and closed sibling PR say bot/v3/info does not provide, so automation should not choose the permanent Feishu identity contract.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework the linked PR or a replacement around a verified Feishu identity source and cover every mention-admission path before merge.

options.title: Document Platform Limitation
options.body: If Feishu does not expose a reliable cross-app bot identity, keep requireMention conservative and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Multi-Bot Design
options.body: Use the broader multi-bot work only if maintainers want one design for mention identity, bot-to-bot visibility, and session scope.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework the linked PR or a replacement around a verified Feishu identity source and cover every mention-admission path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the active linked PR and has already requested changes on the Feishu identity decision surface.
